shots.narration_dhivehi: ކަނޑުހުއްޓާގެ ބިމު އަޑީގެ ދެވަނަ ބާރުގަދަ ގޮވުމާއެކު މުޅި ފަޅުރަށް ހެލިގެން ދިޔަ. ބިންގަރާސް މަތީގައި ހުރި ބޯގަސްތަކާއި ރުއްތައް މުލުންލުހި، މައްޗަށް އަލިފާނުގެ ރަތްކުލަ ފެތުރިގެންދިޔަ.
shots.narration_english: With a second powerful blast from deep under Kandu-huttaa's ground, the whole deserted island shook. The bushes and trees over the bunker were torn apart, and the red of the flames spread upward.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ގޮވުމުގެ ބާރުގަދަ ރާޅާއެކު އަޝްހަމް، ހަބީބު، ރާނިޔާ އަދި ރާނިޔާގެ ބައްޕަ ގޮނޑުދޮށުގެ ހުދުވެލިގަނޑު މައްޗަށް ވިއްސައިގެން ދިޔަ.
shots.narration_english: With the force of the blast, Ashham, Habeeb, Raniya and Raniya's father were flung onto the white sand of the beach.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކަންފަތް ބީރުވާ ފަދަ އަޑުފަށްގަނޑެއް. ގަޑިއެއްހާއިރު ފަސް. އަޝްހަމް މަޑުމަޑުން ދެލޯ ހުޅުވާލި. އޭނާ ބޯ އަނބުރައިގަތް.
shots.narration_english: A deafening, ear-ringing roar. About an hour later. Ashham slowly opened his eyes. He shook his head.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މުޅި ގައިގައި އޮތީ ކުދިކުދި ޒަޚަމް. އަނގަމަތިންނާއި ނޭފަތުން ލޭގެ އަސަރު ފެންނަން ހުރި. އޭނާ ތެދުވެ ވަށައިގެން ބަލާލި.
shots.narration_english: His whole body was covered in small wounds; traces of blood showed at his mouth and nose. He got up and looked around.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބިންގަރާސް ހުރި ސަރަހައްދުން އަދިވެސް ކަޅު ދުން އަރަމުންދޭ. އެތަނުގައި ހުރި ބިރުވެރި ލެބޯޓްރީ ޖެހުނުތާ ލަކުނުވެސް ނެތް. ހަބީބު...
shots.narration_english: Black smoke was still rising from where the bunker had been. Of that terrifying laboratory not a trace was left. Habeeb…
shots.speaker: ashham

shots.narration_dhivehi: ރާނިޔާ... އަޝްހަމް ކުރެހިފައިވާ އަޑަކުން ގޮވާލި. އޭނާ ފިރުކެމުން ކަހަލަ ގޮތަކަށް ގޮސް ވެލިގަނޑު މަތީގައި އޮތް ހަބީބުގެ ކޮނޑުގައި ހިފާ ތަޅުވައިގަތް.
shots.narration_english: Raniya… Ashham called out in a hoarse voice. Half crawling, he went to Habeeb lying on the sand, took him by the shoulder and shook him.
shots.speaker: ashham

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަބީބު ކުއްލިއަކަށް ހޮޑުލަމުން ދެލޯ ހުޅުވި. އޭނާ ސަލާމަތުން އޮތްކަން އެނގުމުން އަޝްހަމް ހިތްހަމަޖެހުމުގެ ނޭވާއެއްލި.
shots.narration_english: Habeeb suddenly coughed and opened his eyes. Knowing he was safe, Ashham let out a breath of relief.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ދުރުނޫން ހިސާބެއްގައި ރާނިޔާ އިނީ އޭނާގެ ބައްޕަގެ ބޯ އުނގަށްލައިގެން ރޯން. ބައްޕަގެ ނޭވާ ހުރި. ނަމަވެސް އޭނާ އޮތީ ހޭނެތިފަ. ހާޑްޑްރައިވް...

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަބީބު ފުރަތަމަވެސް ބެލީ މުހިންމު ހެކި ސަލާމަތުން އޮތްތޯ. އަޝްހަމް އަވަސްއަވަހަށް އޭނާގެ ޖީބަށް އަތްބޭނި.
shots.narration_english: Habeeb's very first concern was whether the vital evidence was safe. Ashham quickly reached into his pocket.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފޮރެންސިކް ޑޭޓާތައް ހުރި ކުޑަ ހާޑްޑްރައިވް އޮތީ ސަލާމަތުން. އަހަރެމެން މިހާރު މިތިބީ މި ފަޅުރަށުގައި ތާށިވެފަ.
shots.narration_english: The small hard drive with the forensic data was safe. We're stranded on this deserted island now.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބޭރު ދުނިޔެއާ ވަކިވުން: އެމީހުން އައި ކުޑަ ޑިންގީ އޮތީ ރަށުގައި ގޮވި ގޮވުމާއެކު ފަރުމައްޗަށް ވިއްސައިގެން ގޮސް ކުދިކުދިވެފަ.
shots.narration_english: Cut off from the outside world: the small dinghy they came in had been flung onto the reef by the blast and smashed to pieces.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިންޖީނު އޮތީ ފުނޑުފުނޑުވެފަ. ހަބީބު އޭނާގެ ޓެބްލެޓް ހުޅުވަން މަސައްކަތްކުރި. ނަމަވެސް އެކަމެއް ނުވި. ސަރ،
shots.narration_english: The engine was in fragments. Habeeb tried to switch on his tablet, but it wouldn't work. Sir,
shots.speaker: habeeb

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއްކޮށް މިދިޔައީ. ނުވެސް ހުޅުވޭ. އަޅުގަނޑުމެންގެ ސެޓެލައިޓް މޮޑެމްވެސް ވެއްޓި ހަލާކުވީ،
shots.narration_english: it's completely gone. It won't even turn on. Our satellite modem fell and broke too,
shots.speaker: habeeb

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަބީބު މާޔޫސްވެފައި ބުނި. މާލެއަކަށް، ނުވަތަ ކައިރި ރަށަކަށްވެސް ނުގުޅޭނެ. އަހަރެމެން މިތިބީ ގުޅުން ކެނޑިފަ.
shots.narration_english: Habeeb said in despair. We can't reach Malé, or even a nearby island. We're cut off.
shots.speaker: habeeb

shots.narration_english: Ashham stood up and looked toward the shore. In the distance lay a rough sea; big waves were breaking.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފައިރޫޒް ހީކުރާނީ އެމީހުން ބަންކަރުގެ އެތެރޭގައި ތިއްބާ ގޮވައި މަރުވީ ކަމަށް. އެހެންކަމުން މާލެއިން އެއްވެސް ފުލުހެއް އެމީހުން ހޯދާކަށް ނާންނާނެ.
shots.narration_english: Fairooz would believe they had died in the blast inside the bunker. So no police from Malé would ever come looking for them.

shots.narration_english: Fairooz was sure to have their names marked as dead in the police records. We'll starve to death on this island,

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެންމެންވެސް ތިބީ އަޝްހަމްމެންގެ މަރުގެ ޚަބަރުގެ ތަފްސީލް ހޯދުމަށް ކެތްމަދުވެފަ. އަޝްހަމާއި ހަބީބު ފުލުހުންގެ ގްރޫޕެއްގެ ތެރެއަށް ވަދެ، ސިއްރުން ޢިމާރާތުގެ އެތެރެއަށް ވަން.
shots.narration_english: All of them were impatient for the details of the news of Ashham's group's death. Ashham and Habeeb slipped into a group of police and secretly entered the building.
